newsitem.title: CHINA: China Everbright Bank profits hit $107 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright Bank profits hit $107 mln in 1996.

text.p: China's Everbright Bank recorded profits of 891 million yuan ($107 million) in 1996, the China Business Times said on Wednesday.
It did not say if the figure was pre-tax but Chinese firms usually give pre-tax numbers.
The bank's assets totalled 52.9 billion yuan at the end of last year compared with 775 million yuan when the bank was set up in 1992, the newspaper said.
Yuan deposits were 24.876 billion while foreign currency deposits hit $950 million, it said, adding that deposits had increased at an average rate of 71.1 percent a year over the last several years.
The bank extended 23.89 billion yuan worth of loans in 1996, it said but gave no further details.
Everbright, one of six nationwide commercial banks in China, had 132 shareholders that included large and medium-sized state enterprises and the Asian Development Bank, it said.
